day_shape: 73 items: fresh US Treasury/State sanctions on Hezbollah–Qods Force smuggling network and Bessent vow to 'collapse' the regime, CENTCOM confirms USS George Washington relieving USS Abraham Lincoln with 67 vessels redirected under Iran blockade, heavy Khamenei 40th-day martyr commemorations, fifth Isfahan protest execution.

threads.label: US sanctions and economic pressure track
threads.summary: The State Department announced a renewed Hezbollah FTO designation and Treasury sanctions on ten individuals in a Qods Force–Hezbollah smuggling network, with Treasury Secretary Bessent quoted saying the US will 'collapse the Iranian regime' through economic pressure. Iran International and Jerusalem Post covered Trump's 'Economic D-Day' framing, with Foreign Minister Araghchi predicting 'further defeat' and the IRGC threatening a more destructive response if war resumes.

threads.label: US naval posture in CENTCOM theatre
threads.summary: CENTCOM posted that the USS George Washington Carrier Strike Group arrived in the theatre on 19 August and that, as of 20 August, US forces had redirected 67 commercial vessels, disabled three and boarded two enforcing a blockade on Iran. Defa Press said the USS Abraham Lincoln had departed West Asia after a nine-month deployment, and CENTCOM posted KC-135 refuelling imagery over the Middle East.

threads.label: Israel–Syria–Turkey military friction
threads.summary: Defa Press reported a fresh Israeli ground incursion at Tal al-Dara'iyat in southern Quneitra using two tanks and three armoured vehicles, and Syria's foreign minister told Damascus that Israel had struck the Abu al-Duhur airbase despite assurances of no Turkish base. Jerusalem Post reported a call between Mossad chief Roman Gofman and Syrian FM al-Shaibani on Turkey's Syria presence, and ran an opinion piece on Israel's military response to Ankara.

threads.label: Khamenei 40th-day martyr commemorations
threads.summary: Regime channels covered the fortieth-day commemoration of the 'Mr Martyr of Iran' at Imam Reza's shrine, including Khamenei's attendance and Parliament Speaker Qalibaf's parallel visit to Karbala conveying Khamenei's greetings. Jerusalem Post framed Qalibaf's Iraq trip as Tehran seeking to 'reshuffle relations with Iraq'.

threads.label: Yemen operations and Lebanon strikes
threads.summary: Yemen's military spokesman Yahya Saree claimed drone strikes on Najran airport and an Aramco facility, and Yemen's government spokesman claimed 48 ships blocked and 8 tankers targeted since 20 July. IRIB reported an Israeli air strike on al-Daouh neighbourhood in Kafr Ruman, southern Lebanon.

threads.label: Iran economy: UAE, Turkey, gasoline
threads.summary: Iran International reported the UAE has halted all trade and financial transactions with Iran and that a 25-year Iran–Turkey gas contract expiry has left Ankara with more supply options. A separate Iran International piece covered an energy-optimization survey reigniting debate over Pezeshkian-era fuel price reform.

threads.label: Gaza ceasefire pressure and Nasser Hospital claim
threads.summary: The IDF released intelligence alleging Hamas Internal Security Forces conduct interrogations and torture inside the Yassin building at Nasser Hospital in Khan Yunis, coverage picked up by Jerusalem Post. Turkey, Egypt and Qatar issued a joint statement condemning Israeli strikes in Gaza and demanding ceasefire compliance, and the UN said 94 percent of Gaza's population need shelter.
